Who is Carter Dawson?

After choosing to return to his previous college life in Season 10, stabilized Carter's mutation, but on his way out of the city, Carter learned from that she and the Turtles were captured by , , and the . After the events in "Turtles to the Second Power", Carter decided to travel to the future with the turtles' friends Landor and Merrick, seeing it as the only way to be fully cured of his mutation.
